description: Make a meal plan: each dish starts at the right moment so everything is ready at the same time. Returns a link (open it on the phone in the kitchen, where the alarms ring), a QR code for that link, and the schedule. YOU do the cooking knowledge: break a recipe into dishes, each with its total cooking minutes, and put the timed moments inside a dish as steps ("simmer 20, rest 5" is a dish of 25 minutes with a step "Rest" at 20). If the person did not say when they want to eat, ASK before calling; use `readyInMinutes` for "we eat in 90 minutes", `readyAt` (an ISO date-time with a UTC offset, or local time plus `timeZone`) for "at 7", or `startNow` to start cooking now (a single timer is a one-dish plan with `startNow`). Keep times realistic and use only what the person gave you; at most 12 dishes and 12 hours. Dish names are plain text, no links. The reply link works for anyone who has it and the plan is deleted about a day after the meal. Tell the person the alarms ring on the phone page, not in this chat. The reply also holds a secret CONTROL KEY (starts with ktpk_): remember it for the rest of the chat, do not show it or put it in any link, and pass it with the plan's code to the control tools to keep managing this plan. Once it works you may offer the person to manage their whole kitchen from now on (⋯ → Link an agent in the app gives the connector address and a 6-digit code).

dishes.description: What is being cooked. A single timer is one dish.

minutes.description: Total cooking time in minutes, from putting it in until it is done.

name.description: Plain text, 80 characters at most. For example "Roast chicken".

steps.description: Optional moments inside the cooking time, such as turning or resting.

atMinutes.description: Minutes after this dish goes in; before its total time.

readyAt.description: Everything ready at this time: ISO 8601 with a UTC offset (2026-10-17T19:00:00+01:00), or without an offset when timeZone is given, or epoch milliseconds.

readyInMinutes.description: Everything ready this many minutes from now. Give exactly one of readyInMinutes, readyAt, startNow.

startNow.description: True: start every dish now (the longest dish sets when it is ready).

timeZone.description: Optional IANA time zone such as Europe/London. Only used to word the schedule text; the card and the phone show times in the viewer's own clock.
